x-sap-shortText: Manage Concur meetings and their attendees, including third-party partner meeting integration

info.title: Concur Meetings API
info.description:
API for managing meetings and attendees within SAP Concur.

Supports two primary use cases:
1. **Concur Meetings** – Meetings created directly within Concur via Meetings Admin UI or Joule
2. **Third-Party Meetings** – Meetings created by external partners (e.g., Cvent) via API integration

This is the partner-facing edition of the spec. Internal-only operations are not included.

get.description: Retrieve all meetings for a company with optional filtering. Use `attendeeId` with date params for meeting match.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: Company UUID. Required — scopes listing to this company.

parameters.name: attendeeId
parameters.description: Filter meetings where this user is an attendee. Used for meeting match when combined with startDateFrom/startDateTo and status=active.

parameters.name: startDateFrom
parameters.description: Filter meetings starting from this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: startDateTo
parameters.description: Filter meetings starting before this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: countAttendees
parameters.description: When true, each returned meeting includes an `attendeesCount` field. Adds one count query per meeting; off by default.

get.summary: Get full meeting details (metadata + settings + discounts)
get.description: Retrieve all information about a specific meeting. For partial data, use the /metadata, /settings, or /discounts sub-resource endpoints.

parameters.name: countAttendees
parameters.description: When true, the returned meeting includes an `attendeesCount` field.

patch.description: Update an existing meeting using partial-merge semantics per RFC 7396 — fields omitted from the body retain their existing values.

delete.description: Soft-delete a meeting by setting status to cancelled. Only allowed for meetings with no bookings.

errors.errorMessage: Cannot delete meeting with existing bookings

get.description: Retrieve core meeting information, excluding advance settings and discounts.
Retrieve only the advance settings for a specific meeting.
Retrieve only the discounts for a specific meeting, with optional filtering by travel type.

Returns audit history rows for a meeting and its child entities, newest first.
A single PUT on a meeting can produce up to three rows: METADATA (the meeting record),
SETTINGS, and one DISCOUNT row per affected discount. Attendee history is emitted
by the attendee endpoints. Use `entityType` to narrow the result set.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Restrict to a single child-entity type. Same vocabulary as the response's `sourceEntityType`.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned by a previous call.

get.description: Retrieve all attendees for a specific meeting.

post.description:
Add a single attendee to a meeting.

**Profile Resolution Logic:**
1. If `concurUuid` is provided, use the existing profile (validates against `concurLoginId` if both provided)
2. If not, attempt to match by `email` within the company
3. If no match found and `profileType` is `nonEmployee`, create a Sponsored Guest profile with type "Meeting Traveler"
4. If no match found and `profileType` is `employee`, return an error

errors.errorMessage: Attendee with this email already exists for this meeting

post.description: Add multiple attendees to a meeting in a single request. Returns HTTP 207 Multi-Status: the `results[]` array carries per-item success or error; check `results[i].status` for each.

207.description: Multi-status response — per-item success or error in results[]

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific attendee.

patch.description: Update attendee information using partial-merge semantics per RFC 7396 — fields omitted from the body retain their existing values.

delete.description: Remove an attendee from a meeting.

parameters.name: deleteProfile
parameters.description: If true and attendee is a non-employee with no other associations, delete their profile

post.summary: Generate OTP login URL for a non-employee attendee
post.description:
Generate an OTP-based login URL that partners render as the "Book Travel" link for non-employee attendees.
The partner passes their OAuth credentials as form parameters. The Meetings API validates the request
and proxies the credentials to the Auth service OTP endpoint (which internally uses CTE credentials to generate the OTP).

**Validation performed:**
1. Attendee exists and is a Sponsored Guest of type "Meeting Traveler"
2. Attendee belongs to the specified meeting
3. Meeting belongs to the calling partner's company
4. Partner is listed as the `thirdPartyPartnerId` for the meeting

**Note (documented deviation):** `client_id` and `client_secret` are sent as form-encoded parameters
(`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) in addition to the standard `Authorization: Bearer` header.
See Q7 deviation in the API Design Review Checklist for the defense-in-depth rationale: this endpoint
mints a one-time login URL that authenticates a non-employee meeting attendee into Concur Travel, and
re-authenticating the partner with the same credentials they used at the OAuth token endpoint is a
deliberate additional check.

403.description: Attendee is not a Meeting Traveler or partner is not authorized

errors.errorMessage: Attendee is not a Sponsored Guest of type "Meeting Traveler"
Partner is not listed as the third-party vendor for this meeting
Upstream OTP endpoint returned an error

get.summary: Get company-level form data for meeting creation
get.description:
Retrieve the travel configs and their rule classes for a company. Used to populate
the travel-config and rule-class dropdowns when creating or editing a meeting.
The caller's JWT must belong to the same `companyId`.

snapshot.description:
For CREATE: per-field `{ "<field>": { "after": <value> } }` map of the created entity.
For DELETE: per-field `{ "<field>": { "before": <value> } }` map of the deleted entity.
For UPDATE: per-field `{ "<field>": { "before": <old>, "after": <new> } }` for fields that actually changed.

nextToken.description: Opaque token for the next page; null when there are no more results.

matchingEndDate.description: Meeting match window end (required if enabled)
